//: OpenLane 2 settings for hardening the Shader Core on its own (not the Tiny Tapeout top).
Every other setting comes from src/config.json. Like the Tiny Tapeout flow, .github/workflows/gds.yaml
merges the two, with these taking precedence, and hardens the result. To do the same by hand,
These replace the ones the Tiny Tapeout flow generates from info.yaml (src/user_config.json).
Not the Tiny Tapeout tile: the Shader Core has 429 port bits, so the die is sized for its pins
rather than its cells. Compare the cell area (design__instance__area), not the die area.
